what: Added a hardware-independent turn gate and deterministic replay for cooperative token placement.
why: Test turn requests, hand reentry and observation loss while the station and policy integration are being confirmed.
details: 17 tests pass on Python 3.9.6, with independent code review. Replay demonstrates grant, hand-triggered revocation, explicit re-request, completion and stale-observation revocation. Invalid or repeated capture timestamps cannot extend a grant; late completion cannot end a newer turn. Software-only: no camera detection, Dream-1 call, physical arm connection or audible voice verified. No physical milestone marked complete.
